summary: Complete initial source-scope chronology audit of all 357 Chinese units, all 19 temporal or active-hint items, and all 5 people. This Yuan criminal-law treatise combines named reigns with retrospective legislative summaries, work-title associations, and a later tax-grant reference. Every extracted date and active hint is retained only as an evidence-grounded research hold pending independent identity, ownership, conversion, and endpoint review; no source, extraction, or canonical person data was changed.
